verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents account- and project-level access tokens with explicit scopes. For example, a post_client_item-only token can only send events and cannot read data. Tokens can be disabled and replaced at any time, and new tokens are encrypted after creation, so least-privilege credentials can be issued to an agent. The HN complaint about a default read token is a criticism of defaults, not a contradiction of scoping. Missing for 10: a documented full list of available scopes (read/write/server-side), guidance on scoping tokens specifically for agents or the MCP server, token expiry controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.
